results.description:
I Am Sober is more than just a free sobriety counter app.

Along with tracking your sober days, it helps you build new habits and provides ongoing motivation by connecting you to a wide network of people all striving for the same goal: staying sober one day at a time.

Through our growing sober community you can learn from others and contribute by sharing insights and tactics that have worked for you.

**The I Am Sober app features:**

• Sober day tracker
To visualize how long you’ve been sober.

• Remember why you quit
Add reasons and photos to help you remember why you want to quit your addiction and stay sober.

• Daily pledge tracker
Take a pledge every day. Sobriety is a 24-hour struggle, so start your day off by making a pledge to stay sober. Then you can review how your day went and log notes at the end of the day.

• Sobriety calculator
View how much money & time you’ve saved by being sober.

• Analyze triggers
Recap each day and find patterns that made your day easier or more challenging than the last.

• Share your story
Either with others or for yourself, take photos and journal your progress directly in the app. Then choose to share it or save it as a reminder for yourself.

• Milestone tracker
Track and celebrate your milestones from 1 day, to 1 week, to 1 month and beyond. Compare experiences with others on their sober journey. Read how they felt at this milestone and what you can expect. If you’re struggling, share your story and invite others to offer help or advice.

• Withdrawal timeline
When you create an account and declare your addiction, you can instantly see a withdrawal timeline to get an idea of what to expect for your next few days (and weeks). What’s more, you can contribute to it. See how many others saw an increase in their restfulness vs those that saw an increase in anxiety. Prepare yourself for what’s to come in recovery.

• Customize your experience
You set the time, your sober birthday, the category of motivation you need, the addictions you’re trying to break, even the end-of-day summaries. Make the app customized to your lifestyle and tailored to your needs.

**Sober Plus subscriptions**

I Am Sober is free to use, but you can support development of the app with a subscription to Sober Plus. With Sober Plus, you'll get access to these premium features:

• Create a group
Stay accountable together and track your sobriety privately. Groups are great for complimenting your real-world group like Alcoholics Anonymous, NA, SA, SMART Recovery, or your rehab center.

• Locked access
Keep your trackers private with a lock that you can access via TouchID or FaceID.

• Data Backups
Save your progress in the cloud and restore your trackers if you get a new device.

• More tracking
Track more addictions and get access to more communities. Even if your addiction is specific like Wine, Online Shopping, or Skin Picking, you’ll find a variety of communities of people who are all trying to get sober from alcohol, drugs, eating disorders, self-harm, and more.

Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. I Am Sober Plus automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.

Hi! My name is Parker. I'm not a company. I'm just a guy in recovery who made Nomo as a tool to keep me on track and motivated. Nomo is short for, "No More". It's a passion project of mine and I hope it helps you as much as it has been helping me!

If you're looking for a simple clock that can track the number of days you've been sober/clean/etc, then Nomo is perfect for you. You can create as many clocks as you need for any hurts, habits, or hang ups. Your clocks are completely private by default and will count those days for you.

If you're looking for something more, just check under the hood. Nomo has tons of optional features like an encouragement wall from the community, accountability partner searching, clock sharing, private messaging with partners, milestone tokens, journaling, daily inventory check-ins, little games/exercises to help you refocus when you're tempted, and tons more!

•  Create as many sobriety clocks as you need

•  Find accountability partners!

•  Share selected clocks with accountability partners

•  Send a notification to partners when you're feeling tempted

•  Send/Receive notifications when a clock has been reset

•  Get a detailed breakdown of your progress down to the minute

•  See how much money you've saved by not supporting your habit

•  Earn tokens when you reach certain milestones in your recovery

•  Submit and read encouragements from the community

•  View all of your tokens at once to keep you encouraged

•  Tap the “check in” button on your shared clocks to show accountability partners that you’re active in your sobriety

•  Keep a daily inventory with morning and evening check-ins

•  Mini-distraction exercises to help you refocus when you’re feeling tempted

•  Prevent someone from accessing your Nomo app with a secure PIN and/or Face/Touch ID.

Nomo is perfect for anyone recovering from Alcohol, Anger, Body Dysmorphia, Benzodiazepines, Caffeine, Cheating, Chewing Tobacco, Codependency, Contact, Control, Exercise, Depression, Dermatillomania, Drugs, Fighting, Food, Gambling, Hallucinogens, Hoarding, Inhalants, Internet, Kleptomania, Laziness, Lying, Masturbation, Nicotine, Onychophagia, Opioids, Painkillers, Perfectionism, Pornography, Procrastination, Pyromania, Relationships, Self-harm, Sex, Shame, Smoking, Social Media, Shopping, Steroids, Stimulants, Stress, Sugar, Tanning, Texting, Trichotillomania, Tobacco, Video Games, Work, or any other kind of hurt, habit, or hangup. Sunflower is the ultimate Sober Quit Tracker!

It comes with a days clean tracker where for every day you stay sober, you earn a sunflower through what’s called Visual Progression Tracking. This helps your brain associate sobriety with reward.

Sunflower supports all substance types. Use it to stop drinking alcohol, to quit smoking nicotine or weed, or any other kind of addiction.

Sunflower Features

• Sober Days Clean Tracker

Count how many days you’ve quit & stayed sober from alcohol, nicotine, weed, or any other substance. Every day you stay sober, you’ll earn a sunflower.

• AI Sponsor

Get an AI Sponsor to talk to 24/7 to help you stay sober. Walk through cravings, vent about life, get advice about sobriety, and celebrate milestones with Sam!

• Milestone Tracker

Track your sober milestones with Sunflower! Whether it’s one second, one minute, one day, one month, one year, or ten years - celebrate your milestones to stay motivated and keep going.

• Reset Quit Date

Relapse happens & it’s important to remember to be kind to yourself. You can easily reset your quit date when needed with Sunflower to start tracking days clean.

• Exercises

Sunflower comes with exercises to overcome cravings and help your mind associate sobriety with reward. Learn about the common fallacies of an addicted mind and how to overcome them to stay sober.

• Community

Celebrate your wins and share your challenges with other users of Sunflower.

This app is built around the core concept that it's not enough to simply "stop", but that you must learn new ways to seek reward, pleasure, and dopamine.

It's a little silly, but earning a Sunflower for every day you stay sober, is a strong way to reinforce the rewards of sobriety.

It's not a "digital make believe Sunflower".

It's a day sober. It's a dinner with your family. It's a paper you wrote for school. It's a new skill you improved. It's your body regaining its health. It's a step towards not just recovery, but to a better and improved life.

One Sunflower at a time.

The app comes with built in guided journaling exercises for activities and cravings. If you follow them, they are designed to help you associate activities like exercise, being social, and learning, with reward.

Learn to associate something like exercise with reward or pleasure, and watch as your cravings change from destructive to empowering.

Looking to stop drinking or smoking? I hope you find Sunflower the absolute best way to keep track of your sobriety.

Sober October is a fun way to insert a little mindfulness into your daily routine.
We’ve chosen four simple things to focus on: drinking less, and sleeping, reading, and exercising more. That’s it. We added a basic point system, a leaderboard, and just enough competition to gamify the whole thing.
Join an existing challenge or start your own. Do it with friends for some added accountability, or create a challenge just for yourself.
It’s an honor system. Log your day, earn your points, and try to get one day right at a time. Stack a few good days together and you might find yourself building some momentum.
Along the way, you can track your progress, climb the leaderboard, chase Perfect Days, compete for discipline trophies, share photos and comments, and keep up with everyone else in your challenge.
The goal isn’t necessarily to become a completely different person for one month. Maybe you just prove to yourself that you CAN do it. Maybe a few healthier habits stick around after October.
And despite the name, nobody says you have to wait until October.
Sober October. Sober November. Random-three-weeks-in-March. We’re not picky.

results.description:
How many sober days this year? How long since the last cigarette? And what if one hard day did not wipe out the rest? Sobright counts your sober days and shows the year as 365 dots. The count never resets, and the widgets are free.

YOUR YEAR, ONE DOT A DAY
Each evening you say how the day went. A sober day lights its dot, a hard day stays dark, a day without an answer stays empty. The number that matters is the count of sober days: this month, this year, in total.

NOTHING GOES BACK TO ZERO
There is no streak to lose. A hard day is one dark dot, and tomorrow counts like any other. No message, no lecture, no number that drops.

SEVERAL SUBJECTS AT ONCE
Alcohol, tobacco, sugar, screens, gambling, or a word of your own. Each subject has its card and its own Sober today button on the home screen. Three are free.

ANY DAY, ANY TIME
Last week slipped by? Tap a past dot and mark it. Want to be honest about a day? Change it. No confirmation, no judgement.

A CHALLENGE FOR THE MONTH
Doing Sober October, or 30 days without sugar? Start a challenge on any subject: this month, next month or 30 days from today. Its days are circled in your year, the home card counts them (October · 12/31 means 12 sober days of 31), and a card under the Sober today button says Day 12 of 31. Joining on October 3? The first two days can still be marked. A hard day in a challenge is one dark dot, nothing more. When it ends, it tells you how many days were sober, say 24 of 31, and offers an image of the month to share.

THE EVENING REMINDER
One question at the time you choose: how did today go? Answer from the notification. Already answered? No reminder that day.

WIDGETS, FREE FOR EVERYONE
Your year in three sizes, on the Lock Screen and in StandBy, and a check-in widget with two buttons that answers without opening the app. Never behind a subscription.

WHAT IS FREE
The year in dots, the daily check-in, any past day, the reminder, every widget, challenges, your year as an image to share, 3 themes, 3 subjects. No account, no ads, no community, no AI, no tracking: your days never leave your iPhone.

SOBRIGHT+
As many subjects as you like, all 9 themes, a line of notes on any day, and your trends once you have two weeks of check-ins: the most and least sober days of the week, the last 30 days next to the 30 before, your year so far, your months, your subjects compared. Sobright+ Monthly: $2.99 per month. Sobright+ Yearly: $19.99 per year, with 7 days free first, then $19.99 per year. Sobright+ Lifetime: $29.99 once. Prices in US dollars; the app shows your local price. All three include Family Sharing. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Nothing is removed if you stop.

LESS - Alcohol Tracker

Less is a simple, elegant, intuitive tool to help people who drink alcohol do so more mindfully, and make space for more drink-free days. From the creators of ZERO, the top rated fasting app, Less makes it easy to track your alcohol intake so you can stay aware of how much you drink and when. It’s a science-based approach to taking control of your consumption. As the saying goes, “What gets measured gets managed.”

This app is a judgment-free zone. It’s designed to help anyone who wants to moderate alcohol consumption, no matter what the reason. Whether you’re trying to sail through social situations without overdoing it, overwhelmed by the ocean of work functions involving alcohol, or seeking to chart a course toward better health, Less is your companion to navigate these stormy waters.

**This is v1 of “the drinking buddy that helps you drink less.” We’re rapidly iterating and improving, so we welcome feedback to help make Less as upbeat, engaging, and helpful as possible.**

MEET LES AND LESLIE

Choose to experience the journey toward mindful consumption as either Les or Leslie. You’re the captain of this ship, and every decision is yours. As you log drinks, your daily intake affects the weather while your weekly intake affects your speed. Stay under your daily limit to keep the skies sunny. Stay under your weekly limit to keep the wind at your back. If you exceed your limits, you’ll run into stormy weather and slow your progress.

TRACK YOUR JOURNEY

SET LIMITS. Our algorithm will recommend a weekly limit, but you can customize that limit up or down to work at your own pace. 

LOG DRINKS WITH A TAP. Quickly and easily log each drink from the homescreen, or use the widget to add drinks without opening the app for a more discrete tracking experience. 

BUILD STREAKS. Less tracks how many drink-free days you rack up in a row so you can visualize your progress. 

REVIEW YOUR WEEK. See when you drank and how much. Use this information to inform your choices moving forward.

REVIEW YOUR MONTH. The calendar view lets you see your entire consumption history so you can see the big picture of your alcohol intake.

CHART YOUR PROGRESS. Less transforms your inputs into easy-to understand graphs so you can see how your habits evolve over time.

ADDITIONAL FEATURES

With Less, you can…

...Adjust your weekly limits up or down depending on your goals.

...View and edit your history. If you forgot to log a drink, or logged one incorrectly, you can adjust the number from the “past days” screen. 

...View key statistics like your 7-day rolling average, your 28-day rolling average, and total drink-free days since joining.

...See how much drinking is costing you. Less estimates how much money you spend on alcohol. 

...See how alcohol impacts your health. Less estimates how many calories you consume from alcohol.

...Compare streaks. Track drink-free days and weeks within your limit. Compare your current streak to your longest one. 

LEARN MORE IN OUR TIPS TAB

Dig deep with articles, podcasts, and snackable advice, curated by our team of experts. Read studies from trusted sources about the benefits of drinking less. Listen to podcasts from the top minds in nutrition. Find mocktail recipes to help you drink thoughtfully without sacrificing your social life. 

Become part of a global community of people taking this journey toward more mindful drinking habits and drink-free days.

results.description:
One day at a time.

Not Beaten is a gentle companion for staying sober. Somewhere to turn when an urge hits, count the days, and be kind to yourself on the hard ones. No judgment, no accounts, no pressure. Just the next honest day.

WHEN AN URGE HITS
Urges work like waves: they build, they peak, and they pass. Open Not Beaten and ride it out. A quiet timer counts up rather than down. There's no minimum, nothing to fail, and every second already counts. Rate how strong it is before and after, and watch it come back down.

YOUR OWN PLAN
Write it while you're steady: what sets you off, the early signs, what actually helps, the people you can call, and why you started. When it's hard, Not Beaten shows you your own words instead of ours, and your people are one tap away.

THE DAY COUNTER
Your sober days, counted with care. Milestones from your very first day through ten years, and badges that are yours to keep. A setback never takes a badge away. In the first three days of a new run, it counts the hours and minutes, too.

OR A SET STRETCH
Counting a month rather than counting from here on? Point the counter at a finish line instead, for as long as you like. Reaching it ends nothing: your days carry straight on whether you stop there or keep going, and a hard day never fails it. The count just starts again.

WIDGETS
Two free widgets, for your Home Screen and your Lock Screen. Day Counter shows the day you're on and how far it is to your next milestone. Today's Words shows one kind line a day, with your day count if you want it. Tap either one to open Today. They turn over at midnight on their own, even when you haven't opened the app.

WHAT ACTUALLY HELPS YOU
Every urge you ride out, you note how strong it was and what you reached for. Insights reads that back: how far the wave usually falls, how long yours take, and which of hungry, angry, lonely and tired keeps turning up. One tap puts any of it into your plan. Nothing is claimed until there's enough of it to be honest about.

WHAT YOU'VE KEPT
Tell it roughly what a week used to cost, and see what the days add up to. Entirely optional, and invisible if you'd rather not think about money.

A THOUGHT FOR TODAY
A short, kind affirmation each day, written for recovery. Tap for another whenever you need one.

THREE GRATITUDES
A tiny daily practice. Three small true things, with gentle prompts for the days you're drawing a blank.

HOW YOU'RE FEELING
A private space to write the feelings you're carrying. Hard, messy, hopeful: it all belongs here.

A HARD DAY
Log a setback with compassion, never shame. You start fresh the same day, whenever you're ready, and logging one is always one tap away, without being walked through anything first.

INSIGHTS
Your own history, read back to you. The total days you've counted never reset, even when the counter does.

ENCOURAGING NOTES
Gentle affirmations delivered at the times you choose. Up to six a day.

SUPPORT
Your plan, plus free crisis and recovery help one tap away, including the SAMHSA national helpline and the 988 Lifeline.

YOUR WORDS STAY YOURS
No accounts. No ads. No tracking. Everything you write stays on your device. If you like, lock the app with Face ID, Touch ID or your passcode. While it's locked, your widgets stop showing your day count, and the 988 lifeline stays one tap away on the locked screen.

NOT BEATEN PLUS
Not Beaten is free. The urge timer, your plan, the day counter, widgets, the app lock, journal, affirmations, insights, share cards and support all cost nothing, forever. Not Beaten Plus is a one-time purchase (never a subscription) that adds extra themes and dark mode, your own written affirmations, journal PDF export, and deeper insights.

Not Beaten is a self-care and reflection tool. It is not a substitute for professional treatment or medical care. If a day feels bigger than the app, free support is always one tap away in Support.

Know your limit. Own your night.
We use a medically-informed algorithm — designed alongside doctors — to estimate your Blood Alcohol Content (BAC) in real time, based on your weight, gender, drinks consumed, food intake and fatigue.

How it works
Enter what you're drinking and we do the math. Your BAC updates as the night progresses, giving you a clear picture of where you stand — green, yellow, or red.

What is BAC?
Blood Alcohol Content is the percentage of alcohol in your bloodstream. It peaks 30–70 minutes after drinking. Despite what you've heard, nothing lowers BAC except time — not coffee, not cold showers, not water. We'll tell you exactly when you're clear.

What you get
- Real-time BAC tracking with a traffic light system
- Notifications when you're fit to drive again
- Hydration reminders to stay ahead of the hangover
- Hangover predictions so you know what tomorrow looks like

AlcoLog helps you understand your drinking with session tracking, habit scoring, personal goals, smart alerts, insights, and a fully functional sober support mode. One app, two modes. No judgment, just awareness.

SOBER MODE
Switch modes and AlcoLog counts alcohol-free days instead of drinks. A ten-second check-in each evening, a breathing exercise to ride out a craving, milestones marked as they land, and a running total of the money and calories you have not spent. Slipped? Tell AlcoLog. Your days stay in your history, and you can switch back to tracking whenever you want.

ALCOSCORE HABIT SYSTEM
A 0-100 habit score across six weighted pillars: frequency, intensity, trend, control, behavior and recovery, on a rolling 28-day window. Every session ends with Proud Points, Pinch Points and helper/harmer notes.

PERSONAL GOALS
Pick a goal at setup: cut back, stay under a limit, build sober days, or quit entirely, which turns on Sober Mode. AlcoLog tracks weekly progress with no nags. Hit a 4-week under-target streak or a sobriety milestone for a celebration card.

REAL-TIME SESSION TRACKING
Start a session and log drinks. Units, calories, cost, count and timer tick in real time. Dynamic Island, Live Activities and Smart Stack widgets add a drink, log water or end the session. Forgot last night? Add it as a past session.

1,174 DRINKS, 92 SIZES, 8 REGIONS
596 beers and ciders, 441 spirits and seltzers, 93 liqueurs, 44 wines, 44 cocktail recipes, 42 alcohol-free brands. Glass sizes follow your region.

PHOTO, MENU & RECEIPT SCANNING
Snap a photo of your drink to auto-fill type and size. Photograph a menu and crop to your drink: AlcoLog reads its name, ABV and that bar's price. Or scan a receipt for the round. Premium, Apple Vision, on-device only.

BARCODE SCANNER (PREMIUM)
Scan any alcohol barcode. AlcoLog queries Open Food Facts, USDA, LCBO and FatSecret for ABV, calories and branded-drink nutrition.

LOCATION TAGGING & HOME LOCATION (PREMIUM)
Every drink is auto-tagged with a friendly place name, and a session map shows where your night went. Auto-start when you leave home, auto-end on arrival, with saved venues. Location stays on your device.

SMART ALERTS
Limits for units (Free) or calories, cost and drinks (Premium). Cross-threshold alerts and auto-incrementing limits. Hydration reminders, motivational notes and session auto-stop.

MEDICATIONS
Log Naltrexone, Gabapentin, Acamprosate, Disulfiram, Nalmefene, Topiramate, and GLP-1 agonists. Track doses, set redose timers, pin reminders to venues. Built for the Sinclair Method and other evidence-based approaches.

WIDGETS, SIRI AND APPLE WATCH
Home and Lock Screen widgets in every size. Premium adds 10 Siri Shortcuts, Smart Stack widgets, and the Watch app: AlcoScore, sessions, drink logging, medications, and 15 complications with real-time sync.

HISTORY AND INSIGHTS
Calendar heatmap reveals patterns. Trend graphs track units, drinks, calories and cost. Sober-streak trophies mark your best runs. Export to CSV (Free) or PDF (Premium, unlimited).

PRIVACY FIRST
Your drink log never reaches AlcoLog's servers; Premium backs it up daily to your own iCloud. No account required. No third-party analytics, ads, or crash SDKs. Anonymous data sharing is off by default.

TWO TIERS
Free: Session tracking, Sober Mode, AlcoScore, personal goals, past sessions, photo recognition, medications, Apple Health sync, 1,174 drinks, widgets, Units alerts, CSV export.
Premium: Everything above, plus iCloud backup, favorites, barcode, menu and receipt scanning, location tagging, saved venues, session map, all alerts, unlimited PDF export, Dynamic Island styles, and the Apple Watch app.

Track smarter. Drink better. Take control.

results.description:
YOUR DRINKS, IN THEIR OWN TIME

Pourtime is a personal drink journal with live pacing. Record what you drank and when you drank it, then see your logged consumption over the course of a session.

LIVE DRINKING PACE
Average pace rises when you log another drink and decreases between drinks after the initial five-minute window. It is the total US standard drinks logged divided by elapsed session hours, with a five-minute minimum denominator.

RECENT INTAKE
See the US standard drinks logged in the past 60 minutes, your session total, and elapsed time. One US standard drink contains 14 grams of alcohol. Intake totals are calculated from the volume and ABV you enter.

TIMESTAMPED DRINK LOG
Add beer, wine, spirits, or another beverage using common values or your own volume and ABV. Choose the actual consumption time, correct an entry, or record an alcohol-free drink at 0% ABV.

SESSION HISTORY
Tap End & Save to keep a session. When your next drink follows a gap of eight hours or more, Pourtime saves the previous log and starts another. Review pacing charts, drink details, estimated calories, and daily logged-intake patterns.

OPTIONAL PROFILE
Add a name and photo if you like. No weight, biological-sex information, or account is required to log drinks.

PRIVACY
Drink logs and your optional profile are stored on your device. Pourtime does not send these records to its advertising SDK. The app includes advertising, which may collect device identifiers, approximate location derived from IP addresses, advertising interactions, and diagnostic information. See our privacy policy and App Privacy disclosures for details. Tracking permission is optional.

REMOVE ADS
An optional one-time purchase removes advertising. Existing purchases can be restored.

UNDERSTAND THE METRICS
Pourtime describes your logged consumption history. It does not measure or estimate blood alcohol content, impairment, alcohol remaining in your body, or when you will be sober. A lower pace or an empty past-hour window does not mean you are unimpaired. Never use Pourtime to decide whether to drive or operate machinery.

Nurture your recovery, one day at a time.

Sobriety isn't just counting days, it's growing into a healthier you. Rooted is a visual sobriety tracker and recovery habit counter where every clean day helps a living plant take root, flourish, and bloom.

Whether your goal is to quit drinking alcohol, stop vaping, quit smoking nicotine, overcome addiction, or build mindful daily habits, Rooted gives your progress a tangible, beautiful home.

WHY ROOTED?
Clinical numbers and cold streak counters can feel discouraging. Rooted visualizes your resilience as a living organism. Every sober day provides passive plant growth, while daily check-ins give it a vital boost. Caring for your plant builds the consistency and self-compassion needed to care for yourself.

CORE FEATURES:

GROW A LIVING GARDEN — Choose from 20 botanical species like Sunflower, Oak, Cherry Blossom, Monstera, and Lavender. Watch your seedling evolve through 100 growth stages with natural wind sway and seasonal color shifts.

IMMERSIVE HOME SCENES — Personalize your sanctuary with living animated environments. Place your plant in a Japanese Zen Garden, a sunlit windowsill, a cozy backyard patio, or a flowing riverbank with dynamic day/night cycles and seasonal weather.

COMPANION PETS & DAILY PLAY — Unlock companion cats and dogs that grow alongside your plant. Level up your companion, play daily hide-and-seek, and visit friends' gardens on playdates.

DAILY WATERING & MINDFUL PLEDGE — Water your plant every morning as your pledge to stay clean. Track mood, log cravings, calculate money saved, and watch consistency bring your plant to full bloom.

PARTNER & COMMUNITY SUPPORT — Recovery is better together. Pair with an accountability partner or sponsor for free. Send encouraging notes, water each other's plants, and cheer on fellow gardeners on the community wall.

INSTANT SOS & COPING PLAN — When cravings hit, activate SOS Mode for immediate access to your personalized coping plan, grounding tools, and one-tap emergency alerts to your partner.

COMPASSIONATE RELAPSE PRUNING — Recovery is a journey. If you slip, Rooted never erases your hard work. Your plant is gently pruned—preserving the story of your growth—ready to heal and flourish again.

PRIVATE JOURNAL & APP LOCK — Write reflections, triggers, and victories in a private diary. Keep your recovery secure with Face ID / Fingerprint App Lock, and export your history to PDF.

HOME SCREEN WIDGETS — Glance at your sober streak and plant right from your home screen with customizable, resizable widgets.

100% PRIVATE & AD-FREE — Your recovery is sacred. Rooted is ad-free, never sells or shares your personal data, and keeps all reflections and partner messages secure.

ROOTED PRO — Rooted is free to download and use for your daily recovery. Rooted Pro is optional and unlocks our full botanical catalog, companion pets, handcrafted pots, custom home scenes, and advanced Mood Trends analytics. It is offered as an auto-renewing subscription or a lifetime purchase. Manage anytime in your store account settings.

TRACK ANY HABIT — Rooted works as a sober day counter and clean time tracker for alcohol, nicotine, vaping, cannabis, caffeine, opioids, stimulants, benzodiazepines, sugar, or any custom habit. Follow a health recovery timeline built for your chosen journey.

A NOTE ON SUPPORT — Rooted is a self-help motivational tool, not a medical device or a substitute for clinical treatment. In a crisis, dial/text 988 (US & Canada) or contact local emergency services.

Plant your seed today and grow through what you go through!

Dehaze: Quit Weed to Grow A tree
Some days your mind feels foggy, restless, or hard to sit still inside. Dehaze turns that feeling into something you can see — a living tree that grows a little stronger every time you show up for yourself. This is the first time ever where there's an app that lets you reset from weed usage by growing a digital tree every day!

Whether you're taking a break, cutting back, resetting your tolerance, or just trying to feel clearer and more present, Dehaze meets you exactly where you are.

YOUR TREE OF LIFE
At the heart of Dehaze is a tree that grows with you. Complete a wellness tool, log how you're feeling, or make it through another clear day, and your tree puts down roots, sprouts new branches, and comes into leaf. It's a quiet, honest picture of your progress — no numbers to obsess over, just something alive that reflects the care you're putting in.

THE DAILY WELLNESS JOURNAL
Check in with yourself in a few taps. Track your mood, energy, sleep, cravings, and clarity, then jot down a short reflection on how the day went. Over time, patterns emerge — what lifts you, what pulls you down — so you get to know yourself instead of running on autopilot.

A TOOLKIT FOR THE HARD MOMENTS
When a craving or a restless wave hits, open your toolkit:
• Grounding breathwork to steady your body
• Short guided meditations to ride out the urge
• Reframe exercises to talk yourself through the moment
• Quick, calming activities for when boredom creeps in
Each tool you finish waters your tree — so getting through a tough moment always leaves you with something to show for it.

TRACK YOUR CLEAR STREAK
Mark your clear days and watch a gentle streak build alongside your tree. Milestones celebrate consistency, never pressure — every day counts, and a reset is just a new sprout, not a failure.

UNDERSTAND YOUR JOURNEY
Educational, bite-sized reads on what your mind and body go through — clarity, sleep, mood, focus, and the science of building better habits — so you always know what to expect and why it's worth it.

GROW A CALMER PHONE
When the urge to reach for old habits hits, start a Focus session. Dehaze helps you set the phone down and put your time somewhere that grows you — your journal, your tools, your tree.

PROGRESS THAT MEANS SOMETHING
Daily check-ins, a growing tree, and quiet milestones turn five minutes a day into real, lasting change — rewarding the person you're becoming, not the streak you're chasing.

No judgment. No shame. Just you, a little daily care, and something living to show for it.

It's time to clear the haze.

SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION
A Dehaze subscription is required for full access to features and content. Payment will be charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing period. You can manage or cancel your subscription at any time in your Apple Account Settings. If you subscribe before a free trial ends, the remaining trial period will be forfeited upon purchase confirmation.

DISCLAIMER
Dehaze is an educational and self-improvement tool designed to support mindfulness, journaling, and healthy daily habits. It is not a medical device and does not provide medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. It is not a substitute for professional care. If you are struggling with substance use or your mental health, please consult a qualified healthcare provider.
